name: Sorakuen Garden
description: A Japanese garden in central Kobe with a teahouse, pond, and the Hassam-an tea room, offering a quiet green retreat within walking distance of Sannomiya.
highlights: A landscaped Japanese garden in central Kobe

en.name: Sorakuen Garden
en.description: A Japanese garden in central Kobe with a teahouse, pond, and the Hassam-an tea room, offering a quiet green retreat within walking distance of Sannomiya.
highlights: A landscaped Japanese garden in central Kobe
en.notes: Open 9:00–17:00 (entry until 16:30); closed Thursdays and year-end holidays. Admission is 300 yen. The Hassam-an teahouse and formal garden are the highlights.

ja.name: 相楽園
ja.description: 神戸市中心部にある日本庭園。茶室や池を配し、三宮から徒歩圏で静かな緑のひとときを過ごせます。
highlights: 神戸中心部の日本庭園
ja.notes: 開園9:00〜17:00（入園は16:30まで）。木曜と年末年始は休園。入園料300円。茶室「八三庵」と庭園が見どころです。
